effect.name: GM Motion Blur
effect.desc: A real sub-frame integration, not a directional smear. The shutter is sampled across its span and the layer is fetched at a different point of the motion path for each sub-sample, so the trail follows the path the layer actually took. Six motion sources including automatic velocity tracking, five shutter profiles, a shutter bias that looks into the past or the future, jittered taps, rolling shutter on rows or columns, a vortex swirl, a radial push, per-channel chromatic smear, four integration modes (blur, brightest, light trail, darkest), adaptive tap count that collapses to one tap when the pixel barely moved, core sharpening and an edge falloff. Motion is measured in layer space, so the blur belongs to the layer.
